routes.name: BE Computer / Software / IT Engineering
routes.entry: +2 Science (Physical) or engineering diploma with Maths
routes.about: The most competitive engineering route into software, networks and data. IOE constituent Regular seats cost around NPR 63k to 1.2 lakh, Full Fee seats around NPR 5.5 lakh, KU around NPR 7 to 8 lakh, and private colleges NPR 10 to 20 lakh.
routes.exam: IOE entrance (TU), KUEE (KU), Pokhara or Purbanchal University entrance

routes.name: BE Civil Engineering
routes.about: Roads, hydropower, tunnels, buildings and water systems. IOE constituent Regular seats cost under NPR 1.2 lakh, Full Fee around NPR 5.5 lakh, and private colleges NPR 9 to 19 lakh. Requires Nepal Engineering Council licence exam after graduation.
routes.exam: IOE, KU, PU or PoU entrance

routes.name: MBBS (Medicine)
routes.entry: +2 Science (PCB) with at least 50% or 2.4 CGPA
routes.about: Public medical academies allocate 75% of seats as government scholarships (only exam, hostel and registration charges apply). MEC fixes paying tuition at NPR 40.23 lakh inside Kathmandu Valley and NPR 45.96 lakh outside, plus hostel and exam charges. Requires Nepal Medical Council licensing exam.
routes.exam: MECEE-BL (200 MCQs, 3 hours) run by the Medical Education Commission

routes.name: BSc Nursing
routes.entry: +2 Science (PCB) with at least 50% or 2.4 CGPA
routes.about: Four-year clinical nursing degree with strong demand in Nepal and overseas. MEC fixes the paying tuition ceiling at NPR 10.36 lakh across 4 years, with scholarship seats available through MECEE-BL rank. Licence from the Nepal Nursing Council is mandatory.
routes.exam: MECEE-BL conducted by the Medical Education Commission

routes.name: BPharm (Pharmacy)
routes.entry: +2 Science (PCB or PCM) or Diploma in Pharmacy with 50% / 2.4 CGPA
routes.about: Hospital, community and pharmaceutical manufacturing roles. MEC sets the paying tuition ceiling at NPR 7.77 lakh, with merit and inclusive scholarship seats via MECEE-BL. Nepal Pharmacy Council licensure is required.
routes.exam: MECEE-BL conducted by the Medical Education Commission

routes.name: BSc CSIT
routes.entry: +2 Science or +2 with Maths and Computer
routes.about: Theory-heavy computer science degree from Tribhuvan University. Good foundation for software, analytics and masters abroad.
routes.exam: TU CSIT entrance (CMAT-style), run per college

routes.name: BCA (Computer Applications)
routes.entry: +2 in any stream (Maths or Computer helps)
routes.about: Application-focused computing: web, mobile and databases. Open to management and science students.
routes.exam: TU or PU entrance as set by the college

routes.name: BBS (Bachelor of Business Studies)
routes.about: The most popular management degree in Nepal. Low cost, easy to study alongside a job.

routes.name: BBA (Business Administration)
routes.about: Practice-led business degree with projects, internships and presentations. Pokhara University, Kathmandu University and TU affiliates.
routes.exam: Entrance or aptitude test and interview

routes.name: BHM (Hotel Management)
routes.about: Hotels, resorts, airlines and cruise jobs. Strong overseas hiring.

routes.name: BA (Humanities and Social Sciences)
routes.about: Sociology, English, Nepali, Political Science, Psychology and more. A flexible base for civil service, teaching and research.

routes.name: BJMC (Journalism and Mass Communication)
routes.about: Reporting, editing, video and digital media. Portfolio matters more than the certificate.

routes.name: BSW (Social Work)
routes.about: Community development, NGOs and government programmes.

routes.name: BEd (Education)
routes.about: Needed for most permanent teaching posts with a teaching licence from the Teacher Service Commission.

routes.name: LLB (Law)
routes.entry: +2 in any stream (5 year) or any bachelor degree (3 year)
routes.about: Bar council exam is needed to practise. Courts, corporate legal teams and government legal work.
routes.exam: University entrance, then Nepal Bar Council exam

routes.name: BSc Agriculture
routes.about: Government, NGOs and agri-business. Agriculture is Nepal's largest employer, and modern farm tech is growing.

routes.name: B.Arch (Architecture)
routes.entry: +2 Science with Maths or Architecture / Civil diploma
routes.about: Five-year design studio degree taught at IOE Pulchowk, Thapathali, Purwanchal, Chitwan Engineering Campus, KU and affiliated colleges. IOE Regular seats cost under NPR 1.5 lakh; private colleges charge NPR 14 to 25 lakh.
routes.exam: IOE or university entrance, plus aptitude test
